WITH biologic_ingredients AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1119119, 'TNF inhibitor'),        -- adalimumab
        (1151789, 'TNF inhibitor'),        -- etanercept
        (937368,  'TNF inhibitor'),        -- infliximab
        (912263,  'TNF inhibitor'),        -- certolizumab pegol
        (19041065,'TNF inhibitor'),        -- golimumab
        (1186087, 'T-cell costimulation modulator'), -- abatacept
        (1314273, 'B-cell depleting anti-CD20'),     -- rituximab
        (40171288,'IL-6 receptor inhibitor'),        -- tocilizumab
        (1594587, 'IL-6 receptor inhibitor'),        -- sarilumab
        (1114375, 'IL-1 inhibitor')                  -- anakinra
    ) AS v(ingredient_concept_id, biologic_class)
), biologic_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bi.biologic_class, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM biologic_ingredients bi
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = bi.ingredient_concept_id
), ra_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
), class_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, bd.biologic_class, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN biologic_drugs bd ON bd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    JOIN ra_patients ra ON ra.person_id = de.person_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY de.person_id, bd.biologic_class
), eligible AS (
    SELECT ce.*
    FROM class_exposures ce
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = ce.person_id
